p4_b0.ocr: In FY2023, Newmont Corporation reported water usage across various mining operations, with GoldMineA utilizing a volume of 120,000 m³ at a cost of $1,200,000 and a water intensity of 0.012; GoldMineB consuming 80,000 m³ for $800,000 and a water intensity of 0.010; CopperMineC at 150,000 m³ for $1,500,000 with a water intensity of 0.010; and PlatinumMineD using 90,000 m³ at a cost of $900,000 and a water intensity of 0.010.
